defs.def: a round object used for throwing, hitting or kicking in games and sports 球
a round object or a thing that has been formed into a round shape 球状物

ex.s: Putting a ball into a round hole.
There was just one thing I hadn’t counted on: My brother chose to bring his dog Toby, a 50-pound ball of fire.
ex.t: 只有一件事我没料到：我弟弟选择带上他的狗Toby——一个50磅重的小火球。

ex.s: I decided to play with him with only one toy for as long as it would keep his interest I expected that one toy would keep his attention for about five minutes, ten minutes, max I chose a red rubber ball—simple, universally available.
ex.t: 我决定只用一件玩具陪他玩，只要还能保持他的兴趣。我预计一件玩具能吸引他约五分钟，最多十分钟。我选了一个红色橡皮球——简单、随处可得。

defs.def: a kick, hit or throw of the ball in some sports 踢出（或击出、投出）的一球

ex.s: It was then known as cuju (kick ball), a game using a ball of animal skins with hair inside.
ex.t: 在20世纪70年代，她的父母双亡，她不得不辍学找工作养活自己。

ex.s: In the Chinese language, cu means to kick" and ju means “a ball made of leather ".
ex.t: 回答完问题后，全班同学都开始写作文。

ex.s: Merit and his team at Environmental Design installed underneath the root ball a platform of seven-inch-diameter,44-foot-long steelbars and, just below the rods, a first set of uninflated airbags ( shown in gray).The team also dug a shallow ramp.
ex.t: 环境设计公司的梅里特及其团队在根球下方安装了一个平台，由直径7英寸、长44英尺的钢条构成，钢条正下方是第一组未充气的气囊（灰色所示）。团队还挖了一条浅坡道。

ex.s: I stopped the ball and kicked it hardly back to the playground.
ex.t: 我停下球，用力把它踢回操场。

ex.s: If a basketball star is. for example，trying to gain a high personal point total，he may take a shot himself when it would be better to pass the ball to a teammate，affecting the team's performance.
ex.t: 例如，如果一名篮球明星试图刷高个人得分，他可能在更适合把球传给队友时自己投篮，从而影响球队表现。

ex.s: After encapsulating the root ball in wire mesh, the movers allowed the tree to acclimate to its new situation for seven months before relocating it.
ex.t: 默里特和他的环境设计团队在根球下方安装了一个由7英寸直径、44英尺长的钢棒组成的平台，就在钢棒下方安装了一组未充气的气囊（灰色显示）。团队还挖了一个浅坡道。

ex.s: In roughly 15 minutes, the movers inflated the airbags to about three feet in diameter to raise the root ball to the surface of the hole.
ex.t: 大约15分钟内，搬运工把气囊充到约3英尺直径，把根球抬到坑面。

ex.s: The white bags were then deflated in about half an hour to lower the sequoia's root ball to the bottom of its hole, The bags were removed, but the metal bars were left with the tree because they rust and degrade over a number of years.
ex.t: 然后白色气囊在约半小时内放气，将红杉根球降到坑底，气囊被取出，但钢条留在树旁，因为它们会在数年内生锈降解。

ex.s: Stories were like air to me and while other kids played ball or went to parties, I lived out adventures through the books I checked out from the library.
ex.t: 故事对我来说就像空气一样，当其他孩子在打球或参加派对时，我从图书馆借阅的书本中体验着冒险。

ex.s: You don't need expensive equipment; even the ball doesn't have to cost much money.
ex.t: 在20世纪70年代，她的父母双亡，她只好辍学去找工作养活自己。

ex.s: All over the world you can see kids playing to their hearts' content with a ball made of plastic bags; just like Pelé did when he was a boy.
ex.t: 他回来后，他们一起吃了很长时间的早餐，然后一起步行去了学校。
